state: Deterministic finite fixtures in tests.rs; ordinary terminating allocation-success execution.
cost: Finite 512 grid subsets; certificate O(n³+nh) per fixture with n<=9, plus bounded extras.
forward: Run deterministic assertions comparing production outputs with independent geometric or exhaustive-pair certificates and stated transformations.
inverse: behavior_complement: Within deterministic fixture runs, exclude a passing assertion when its compared oracle/result values differ. Passing output excludes only exercised counterexamples; it does not imply correctness on unenumerated coordinates or allocator failures.

reverse_reconstruction: A passing test transcript admits every implementation agreeing with all exercised observations, including incorrect implementations differing elsewhere. Exact test output therefore cannot reconstruct source or universal behavior; independent oracles narrow this equivalence class.

oracle_relation: Independent shoelace determinants, source membership, strict CCW turns, support directions normal to all input pairs and degenerate endpoint checks certify 512 subsets of a 3x3 grid. Support maximization uses no production turn helper.

metamorphic_relation: Permutation, duplicates, interior/boundary insertion, positive scaling and translation retain predicted hull output; applying hull twice is unchanged. These relations intentionally admit ambiguous input fibers.

boundary_partition: The full i32 3x3 extremal grid exercises wide cross products; empty, singleton, collinear and duplicate cases exercise dimensional collapse. The mutant retaining collinear vertices must fail endpoint/strict-turn assertions.
checks: Debug/release twice; strict Clippy; compiled mutant; source-bound syntax twice.
limitations: Finite observations are not universal verification; allocator exhaustion untested; syntax projection lacks semantic type resolution and macro expansion. Exact implementation has no approximate execution profile.
